name: footer-status
title: Footer Status
description: A product footer with a service status chip in words and shape, the version, a few links and a way back to the top.

props.name: updated
props.description: When the status was last checked, as text you format: "14:20". Shown in mono after "Updated".

props.name: statusHref
props.description: Where the full status page lives. Makes the chip a link.

props.name: version
props.description: The running version, and the changelog it links to.

props.name: focusTarget
props.description: The id of the element at the top of the page that receives focus after "Back to top".

props.name: legal
props.description: A quiet line at the end: © and the like.

props.name: labels
props.type: { heading?: string; operational?: string; degraded?: string; outage?: string; updated?: string; version?: string; backToTop?: string; newTab?: string; linksLabel?: string }

a11y.text: A footer with a screen-reader-only h2. A role="status" chip says the state in words with a shaped icon (aria-hidden), plus "Updated {time}" when updated is set; with statusHref it becomes a link. The nav is labelled "Product links".
"Back to top" scrolls and then moves focus to focusTarget, setting tabindex="-1" if missing.
Back to top scrolls at once under reduced motion instead of smoothly, and the press scale is dropped.
